note: The one place a car-detail parameter is declared. Adding a parameter here, running `python -m tgbasics.carsearch.spec_fields sync` in the TelegramBasics repo and re-running enrichment is the whole procedure -- no prompt, pydantic model, JSON schema or viewer column is edited by hand. `source` is not decoration: it decides which code path may fill the field, and a per-car fact may never be answered from an LLM's memory.

fields.label: Engine
fields.prompt: Engine type and displacement as sold, e.g. '2.0L turbocharged petrol I4, 190 hp' or 'dual-motor electric, 340 kW'.

fields.label: Gearbox
fields.prompt: Transmission type, e.g. '8-speed automatic (torque converter)', '7-speed dual-clutch', '6-speed manual', 'single-speed reduction gear'. If both manual and automatic are offered, say so.

fields.label: Consumption
fields.prompt: Combined consumption per 100 km with its unit and cycle, e.g. '6.4 L/100 km (WLTP)' or '17.1 kWh/100 km (WLTP)'.

fields.label: Tank / battery
fields.prompt: Fuel tank capacity in litres, or usable battery capacity in kWh for an electric or plug-in hybrid, e.g. '45 L' or '77 kWh usable'.

fields.label: Doors
fields.prompt: Number of passenger doors, counting only side doors -- a tailgate or boot lid is not a door.

fields.label: Roof removable
fields.prompt: Whether the roof can be opened or removed at all (true/false).

fields.label: Roof mechanism
fields.prompt: How the roof opens or comes off, e.g. 'electric folding soft top, operable to 50 km/h', 'manual latch-and-fold soft top', 'lift-out targa panels'.

fields.label: First year
fields.prompt: The first model year of the generation currently on sale, as a four-digit year.

fields.label: Variant
fields.prompt: Generation or variant designation and production status, e.g. 'ND facelift (2024-), soft top and RF hardtop'.

fields.label: Year
fields.prompt: Year of first registration of THIS car, as shown by the advert.

fields.label: Mileage
fields.prompt: Odometer reading of THIS car, copied verbatim including its unit, e.g. '33 642 km'.

fields.label: Fuel
fields.prompt: Fuel or energy type of THIS car as the advert words it, e.g. 'Gasolina', 'Diesel', 'Eletrico'.

fields.label: Colour
fields.prompt: Exterior colour of THIS car exactly as the advert states it. Null if the advert does not state one -- never infer a colour from a photo description or from the model.

fields.label: Stated problems
fields.prompt: Any defect, damage, accident history, outstanding repair, or adverse use the advert itself states about THIS car -- hail damage, a repaired accident, wear, ex-taxi or ex-rental use -- quoted or closely paraphrased. Null if the advert states none. Two rules, both absolute: (1) never write a reassurance, and that includes REPEATING one the advert made -- 'accident-free', 'unfallfrei', 'sem acidentes', 'first owner', 'full service history' and 'good condition' are all claims that the car is fine, so they belong here as null, not as text; (2) null means the advert was silent, and silence does not mean the car is undamaged.
